12. Compleet voorbeeldmodule

Dit hoofdstuk toont een volledige, werkende voorbeeldmodule (notities) van A tot Z. Alle bestanden zijn productieklaar.

12.1 module.json

{
    "id":    "notizen",
    "title": "Notizen",
    "titles": {
        "de": "Notizen",
        "en": "Notes",
        "fr": "Notes",
        "it": "Note"
    },
    "icon":    "sticky",
    "route":   "/notizen/",
    "order":   60,
    "enabled": true,
    "static": {
        "css": ["mod/mod-notizen.css"],
        "js":  ["mod/mod-notizen.js"]
    }
}

12.2 index.html

{% extends 'abpe_ui/base.html' %}
{% load static %}

{% block title %}Notities{% endblock %}

{% block module_css %}
<link href="{% static 'abpe_ui/css/mod/mod-notizen.css' %}" rel="stylesheet">
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid p-4">

    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2>
            <i class="bi bi-sticky"></i>
            <span data-i18n="notizen.title">Notities</span>
        </h2>
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="notizenAdd()">
            <i class="bi bi-plus"></i>
            <span data-i18n="notizen.btn_add">Nieuwe notitie</span>
        </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Lijst van notities als toggle-secties -->
    <div id="notizen-container">
        <div class="text-center py-4">
            <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Nieuw notitieformulier -->
    <div class="toggle-section mt-3" id="notiz-form-section" style="display:none">
        <div class="section-header" onclick="toggleSection(this)">
            <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
            <span data-i18n="notizen.form_title">Nieuwe notitie</span>
            <i class="bi bi-chevron-down"></i>
        </div>
        <div class="section-content open">
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label" data-i18n="notizen.field_title">Titel</label>
                <input type="text" class="form-control" id="notiz-titel"
                    data-i18n-placeholder="notizen.field_title_placeholder">
            </div>
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label" data-i18n="notizen.field_text">Tekst</label>
                <textarea class="form-control" id="notiz-text" rows="4"></textarea>
            </div>
            <button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="notizenSave()">
                <i class="bi bi-save"></i>
                <span data-i18n="notizen.btn_save">Opslaan</span>
            </button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm ms-2" onclick="notizenCancelForm()">
                <span data-i18n="notizen.btn_cancel">Annuleren</span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block module_js %}
<script src="{% static 'abpe_ui/js/mod/mod-notizen.js' %}"></script>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage('{{ current_lang|default:"de" }}', 'notizen');
    }
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

/* mod-notizen.css */

}

12.4 mod-notizen.js

// mod-notizen.js
if (typeof window._notizenLoaded === 'undefined') {
window._notizenLoaded = true;

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const getCsrf = () => document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim())
    .find(c=>c.startsWith('csrftoken='))?.split('=')[1] || '';
function t(key) {
    const keys = key.split('.');
    let val = window.i18nData || {};
    for (const k of keys) val = (val && typeof val === 'object') ? val[k] : null;
    return typeof val === 'string' ? val : key;
}

let _notizen = [];

async function notizenLoad() {
    try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/notizen/');
        _notizen = (await r.json()).items || [];
        notizenRender();
    } catch(e) {
        $('notizen-container').innerHTML =
            '<p class="text-danger">' + t('notizen.error_load') + '</p>';
    }
}

function notizenRender() {
    const container = $('notizen-container');
    if (!_notizen.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted">' + t('notizen.empty') + '</p>';
        return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = '';
    _notizen.forEach(n => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'toggle-section ntz-item';
        div.id = 'notiz-' + n.id;
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="section-header" onclick="toggleSection(this)">
                <i class="bi bi-sticky"></i>
                <span>${n.titel}</span>
                <span class="ntz-date">${n.datum}</span>
                <i class="bi bi-chevron-down"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="section-content">
                <p>${n.text}</p>
                <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" onclick="notizenDelete(${n.id})">
                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i> ${t('notizen.btn_delete')}
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(div);
    });
}

function notizenAdd() {
    const s = $('notiz-form-section');
    s.style.display = 'block';
    const h = s.querySelector('.section-header');
    if (h && !h.classList.contains('open')) toggleSection(h);
    $('notiz-titel').focus();
}

function notizenCancelForm() {
    $('notiz-form-section').style.display = 'none';
    $('notiz-titel').value = '';
    $('notiz-text').value  = '';
}

async function notizenSave() {
    const titel = $('notiz-titel').value.trim();
    const text  = $('notiz-text').value.trim();
    if (!titel) { $('notiz-titel').focus(); return; }
    try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/notizen/', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json','X-CSRFToken':getCsrf()},
            body: JSON.stringify({titel, text})
        });
        if ((await r.json()).success) {
            notizenCancelForm();
            notizenLoad();
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
}

async function notizenDelete(id) {
    if (!confirm(t('notizen.confirm_delete'))) return;
    await fetch('/api/notizen/' + id + '/', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: {'X-CSRFToken': getCsrf()}
    });
    notizenLoad();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', notizenLoad);
document.addEventListener('languageChanged', notizenRender);

} // end IIFE guard

12.6 Aanmaken in één commando

MOD=notizen
mkdir -p apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/$MOD
touch apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/$MOD/module.json
touch apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/$MOD/index.html
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/css/mod/mod-$MOD.css
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/js/mod/mod-$MOD.js
touch apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/de/modules/$MOD.json
python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
supervisorctl restart abpe-django
